page: Microsoft Azure EC32as_v6 is an ECasv6-family virtual machine powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning it relies entirely on external storage options. It is Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach high-performance external disks. The instance does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard GPUs, with a GPU count of zero.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU, the EC32as_v6 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local ephemeral storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This profile is suitable for memory-optimized workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise applications requiring substantial RAM capacity without local disk dependencies.
